description: The functionality of this chart is that the user can select Top N (number of items to be displayed in the chart by a numerical value), and the rest of the items are grouped into a category called "Others." This is a stacked bar chart, which means each bar can be grouped into different categories using one category dimension. Key Features: Flip X and Y Axis: Users can rotate the chart (from vertical to horizontal). Zoom Capability: Users can zoom into a certain section of the chart. Growth Trends and Connectors: Ability to add growth trends and connectors on command. Flag Data Point Differences: Users can select two points in the chart, and through a tooltip or right-click, they can view basic statistics like sum, average, and difference between those points. Custom Ranges: Users can change and select custom ranges displayed on the Y-axis of the charts. Reference Lines: Ability to add reference lines on command. This chart's full features are available after purchasing a license. For pricing details, please click on the Office Solution logo available on the visual.
